title: Ledger of deleted decision records
description: docs/decisions/superseded.yaml: one entry for each record that a pull request deleted. The decisions check validates the file against this schema. The entries are those of the ledger in sealambda/infra, except that `successor` is optional: an entry without it is a withdrawn record.

number.description: The number of the deleted record, as a quoted string so that YAML keeps the leading zeros. Numbers are never reused.

title.description: The title of the record at its last text.

commit.description: The full hash of the last commit on `main` that changed the file. That commit holds the last text of the record.

path.description: The path of the record in that commit: a relative POSIX path without a leading slash and without a `..` segment. It is not always docs/decisions/: the folder can have had another name then. The file name is four digits, a dash and a slug, and ends in .md: NNNN-slug.md. The check also compares the four digits with the `number`.

successor.description: The number of the record in force that replaced this one. When several records took over parts, the one that took over the decision itself. Omitted when the record is withdrawn: it no longer applies and has no replacement.

date.description: The day the record was replaced or withdrawn.
